human_in_loop_decisions: Every shortlist threshold decision requires named human review; every terminal rejection must be human-issued with documented rationale; every candidate must have access to a human appeal path
strongest_guardrails: No automatic terminal rejection; mandatory subgroup bias evaluation before launch; recruiter override monitoring; stop-and-suspend threshold when disparity is detected; candidate transparency notice
cross_industry_pattern: In high-stakes AI deployments across industries the most severe harms arise not from model errors alone but from missing governance structures — absent audit mechanisms, no appeal path, and lack of transparency to affected parties compound model risk into systematic harm. Evidence from HR shows that even rule-based automation without ML can cause discrimination at scale when human review is removed from the rejection path.
